title: BikePilot — Cycling Computer
description: BikePilot — a focused cycling computer for iPhone.

hero.lead: BikePilot turns your iPhone into a focused cycling computer — with live ride data, heart-rate zones, maps, GPX navigation and a clear ride summary.

features.title: Ride data
features.text: Speed, distance, time, altitude and heart rate in a clear dashboard designed for riding.

features.title: Navigation
features.text: Follow your route on the map, track GPX rides and find your way back home.

features.title: Ride story
features.text: After the ride, see the smart summary of your ride at a glance.
